observation: The sheet appears nearly flat and static on the line, with little evidence of strong gust-driven deformation.
expected_behavior: A large bed sheet should billow outward into sail-like shapes, show taut tension near attachment points, and exhibit visible ripples/collapse phases consistent with wind.
actual_behavior: The cloth reads as a narrow, mostly planar hanging panel with minimal curvature, little tension variation, and no obvious wind energy. The line also appears too rigid with little sag.
